description: Vaadin Flow add-on for running long work in the background from a Vaadin UI, with a task center, a tray, toasts and native notifications that follow each Task's progress in every browser tab of the session.
rules: Turn on server push with @Push on the AppShellConfigurator, and put new PulseCenter() in the main layout's navbar.
Start work with PulseTaskList.getCurrent().start(action, work); the work reports only through its PulseTaskContext and holds no view or component, because a Retry runs it again.
An Action has at most one Running Task per session: bind the start button to Signal.not(taskList.isRunning(action)).
Mark work that must not run twice, such as a payment, with new PulseAction(name, mode, Retry.NEVER).
